newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank market quiet before holiday.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank market quiet before holiday.

text.p: The private sector interbank market on the Egyptian pound saw little activity on Wednesday as banks settled accounts ahead of the three-day weekend, bankers said.
"No one wants to be long or short," a banker said. Banks will be closed on Thursday for Labour Day.

Three of the four major players polled said they did not make any overnight or one-week deals. One banker said he traded at between seven and eight percent overnight, while his one-week deals ranged from eight to 8-1/2 percent.
Rates were between 7-1/2 and 9-1/4 percent in the overnight market on Tuesday. Bankers also said public sector banks had kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-/12 percent.
